fields.title: 📖 Ibn Baṭṭah: Do not let Ahl al-Bidʿah into the heart
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Baṭṭah al-ʿUkbarī** said:

> ***“Ibn Baṭṭah gathered the warnings of the early Imāms against listening to Ahl al-Ahwāʾ or sitting with them.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The heart is weak. Whoever deliberately opens it to people who confuse exposes his Dīn to needless danger.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Baṭṭah, al-Ibānah al-Kubrā, Kapitel über das Meiden von Ahl al-Ahwāʾ.
